full_prompt_en: A square close photographic image centers a young adult face against a nearly black, featureless background. The head faces almost straight toward the camera and fills the frame from forehead to chin, with the outer hair and shoulders largely omitted. Both blue-gray eyes remain visible beneath an extravagant field of paint; one is crisply focused and the other a little softer. The mouth is closed and relaxed, with natural muted pink lips, creating a quiet expression beneath the energetic color. Dense pigment begins around the bridge of the nose and spreads outward across the brow, temples, upper cheeks, and the spaces beside the eyes. Cobalt blue, turquoise, violet, yellow, orange, red, green, and white overlap in irregular bands, pointed flicks, splashes, and short raised ridges. Several streaks fan away from the central face like quick brush gestures, while small speckles break into the adjacent bare skin. The paint is not a flat digital overlay: its thickness catches tiny highlights, and edges vary from opaque hard marks to thinner translucent smears. Soft frontal illumination keeps the skin smooth and pale and lets the saturated paint retain its separate hues. The surrounding darkness pushes all attention to the eyes and pigment without adding a setting or story. The composition is symmetrical in the broad placement of the head but asymmetrical in the exact color strokes, which extend farther and turn differently on either side. Depth of field is shallow, giving the central features photographic clarity and a slight softening toward the perimeter. No readable text, accessories, or other figures are present. The visual force comes from bright, tactile color set against a calm, plainly photographed face and a black ground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形近景摄影将一张年轻成年人的脸置于近乎全黑、没有可辨物件的背景前。头部几乎正面朝向镜头，从额头到下巴占满画面，外侧头发与肩膀大多被裁去。两只蓝灰色眼睛仍从绚烂彩绘之下显露；一只清晰聚焦，另一只略柔。嘴闭合而放松，自然的淡粉色嘴唇让剧烈色彩之下保持安静神情。浓厚颜料从鼻梁周围开始，向外铺过眉部、太阳穴、上脸颊和眼旁。钴蓝、青绿、紫、黄、橙、红、绿与白交叠成不规则色带、尖锐甩笔、飞溅点和短而隆起的颜料脊。数道色痕像迅速挥出的笔迹，从脸中央向两侧扇形展开，细小斑点则散入旁边裸露的皮肤。颜料不是平面的数字叠层：厚处接住微亮反光，边缘有不透明的硬笔触，也有较薄而透底的涂抹。柔和正面光让皮肤显得平滑浅亮，同时保留各个高饱和色相。四周的暗色使视线全落在眼睛与颜料上，不加入场景或故事。头部大体居中对称，具体色痕却不对称，左右延展长度与转折各异。浅景深使中央特征具有摄影清晰度，周边则略为柔化。没有可读文字、配饰或其他人物。画面的力量来自鲜亮、可触的颜色与平静、直接拍摄的面容及黑色背景之间的关系。
style_prompt_en: The close photographic treatment places luminous, saturated pigment against a smooth pale surface and a deep near-black field. Cobalt, turquoise, violet, yellow, orange, red, green, and white keep their distinct chroma even where quick strokes overlap. Broad sweeping marks are interrupted by sharp flicks, scattered speckles, thin smears, and thicker raised deposits that catch pinpoint highlights. Soft frontal light preserves subtle middle tones beneath the color, while shallow depth of field makes the central marks and small details clear and lets the outer perimeter ease into softness. A broadly centered arrangement carries asymmetrical bursts that fan away from the middle, giving movement to an otherwise still composition. The finish is tactile and photographic, with visible pigment thickness, crisp local edges, and restrained retouching rather than uniform digital color. The contrast between calm dark negative space and explosive color is the principal visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 近景摄影处理把发亮的高饱和颜料置于平滑浅色表面与深近黑色域之间。钴蓝、青绿、紫、黄、橙、红、绿与白即使在急促笔痕交叠处也保持不同色相。宽阔扫痕被尖锐甩笔、散布斑点、薄涂痕与接住针尖般高光的隆起厚涂打断。柔和正面光保留色彩下细微中间调；浅景深使中央痕迹和微小细节清楚，外缘逐渐柔化。大体居中的安排承载从中部向外扇形爆开的不对称色块，为本来静止的构图带来动势。表面可触而具摄影质感，能看见颜料厚薄、局部清利边缘和克制修饰，并非均匀的数字上色。安静深暗留白与爆发性色彩的对照构成主要视觉节奏。
theme_en: A close photographic face with vivid multicolored paint sweeping across the upper features
theme_zh: 近距离摄影中，鲜艳多色彩绘横扫面部上方
name: Facepaint
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
